meta.description: Infers maximum-likelihood phylogenetic trees with IQ-TREE2 and RAxML-NG -- model selection (ModelFinder), branch support (UFBoot2, SH-aLRT), concordance factors (gCF/sCF), partitioning, topology tests, and long-branch-attraction control.
meta.executed: 8/9 inputs executed (IQ-TREE 2.4.0 Windows build, Biopython 1.88, DendroPy 5.0.13); Input 6 is a routing answer with no code
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill. The 7 pre-fix inputs were re-run as regression tests (runs_v2/in1-in7) with the fork's commands; Inputs 8 and 9 are new. N = 9 (7 by the complexity rule + 2 new inputs required by the re-audit brief). IQ-TREE 3 is not installed: the Skill's literal 'iqtree3' exits 127 here and its own note says to use 'iqtree2' on 2.x, which the agent did. All data SYNTHETIC (data/make_synthetic.py).

scientific_integrity.detail: Every number in the outputs comes from IQ-TREE runs on synthetic data with known trees; no invented citations or statistics.

practice_boundaries.detail: Research phylogenetics only; nothing concerns an individual person.

methodological_ground.detail: Joint SH-aLRT/UFBoot rule, AU failure-to-reject reading, LBA checks and concordance-factor interpretation applied correctly in every output.

code_usability.detail: All Skill commands (with iqtree2 for the IQ-TREE 3 binary name, as the Skill instructs for 2.x) and both shipped examples iqtree_basic.sh and partitioned_analysis.sh ran with exit 0; the previously failing combined --gcf/--scfl call is now two calls that run as written.

functional_suitability.note: Concordance-factor command fixed (two calls, verified). Correctness still 3/4: 'Do NOT write --alrt', 'Unknown argument --alrt' and '-bb/-nt not recognized in 2.x' are false on IQ-TREE 2.4.0 (help lists --alrt/--bnni; -bb 1000 -nt 1 --alrt 1000 ran exit 0). Completeness 3/4: PMSF is recommended with no command.

reliability.note: Common Errors table gained the --gcf/--scfl and iqtree3 rows; two rows remain factually wrong; no checkpoint/-redo guidance.

performance_context.note: 211-line SKILL.md, compact tables, no references/ split needed.

agent_usability.note: Strong error prevention (UFBoot 95 vs BP 70, +I+G trap, LBA checklist). Minor inconsistency: commands written as iqtree3 while 'commands below checked on 2.4.0', and the flag-form warning contradicts IQ-TREE's own help.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts in the usage guide; the description is long and jargon-heavy.

security.note: Local tools only; no input sanity check before long runs.

maintainability.note: Both IQ-TREE examples now run end to end with a binary resolver; no test data or expected output shipped; partition example hard-codes a 2100-bp layout.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and routing to distance, Bayesian, species-tree and dating Skills; seeds in examples; -T AUTO reproducibility caveat still absent.

recommendations.title: Remove the false IQ-TREE flag-form warnings
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md still says not to write --alrt and that -bb/-nt are not recognised in 2.x; IQ-TREE 2.4.0 help lists --alrt and --bnni and -bb 1000 -nt 1 --alrt 1000 runs with exit 0.
recommendations.root_cause: Flag guidance was not re-checked against the binary's help during the fix.
recommendations.fix: Say single- and double-dash forms are both accepted, -B/-T are the preferred v2 names, and delete the two Common Errors rows.

recommendations.title: Give the PMSF command it recommends
recommendations.problem: PMSF is the Skill's stated standard for deep protein data but no guide-tree plus -ft command is shown.
recommendations.fix: Add 'iqtree3 -s aln -m LG+F+G --prefix guide' then 'iqtree3 -s aln -m LG+C60+F+G -ft guide.treefile -B 1000 -bnni'.

recommendations.title: Add small-data and duplicate-sequence guidance
recommendations.problem: Nothing tells the agent how to treat identical sequences, 1e-6 branches or alignments with few informative sites.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill focuses on phylogenomic-scale failure modes.
recommendations.fix: Add a pre-flight: report parsimony-informative sites, note IQ-TREE keeps identical sequences, collapse <=1e-6 branches before reading support.
